summary: All 6 acceptance criteria for signup/login/forgot-password flows verified via browser checks. Authentication is mocked/localStorage-based (per spec_deviations), so no API-bearing criteria exist and no backend test files were required.

checks.criterion: Create Account collects full name, email, target exam, current class, password, and confirm password
checks.name: signup-form-has-all-fields
checks.evidence: Verified /signup renders signup-name-input, signup-email-input, signup-target-select (JEE Main, JEE Advanced), signup-class-select (Class 11, Class 12, Class 12 pass-out), signup-password-input, signup-confirm-password-input. Also re-ran against public URL https://concept-solver-ai-1.preview.emergentagent.com - passed.

checks.name: signup-rejects-mismatched-passwords
checks.evidence: Submitted password=Password123, confirm=Password999; signup-error-message appeared with text matching /match/i and URL stayed on /signup.

checks.criterion: Valid signup creates the demo account
checks.name: signup-creates-account-and-navigates
checks.evidence: Filled all valid signup fields with unique tscheck-create-<ts>@example.com, submitted, URL navigated to / (AI workspace).

checks.name: signup-profile-data-persists
checks.evidence: Signed up as 'Tscheck Persist User' with JEE Advanced / Class 12 pass-out; Profile page showed matching profile-name, profile-study-status, and avatar initials 'TU'.

checks.criterion: Custom signup credentials can log in
checks.name: custom-signup-credentials-login
checks.evidence: Signed up with unique email/password, logged out via profile-logout-button (redirect to /login), then logged back in with the same custom email+password; URL returned to / (AI workspace).

checks.criterion: Forgot Password uses the registered signup email
checks.name: forgot-password-accepts-registered-email
checks.evidence: After signup, submitting an unrelated email on /forgot-password showed forgot-password-error and stayed on page; submitting the registered signup email navigated to /forgot-password-sent.
